scope: Actual root-agent view_image inspection of five native PNG files at1536x1024; no original-game geometry or costume certification.
observations: All four enemies have four separated whole silhouettes, including a horizontal down pose. The husk is unarmed.
Sniper has a longer generic rifle, destroyer a bulkier grey/red shell; these are prototype distinctions, not a complete primary reference comparison.
Joker idle/pilot drawings both include the chair, body, hands and boots. The face is readable in the native file viewed here.
Low-alpha coloured fringes are visible in native previews and remain documented; no pixel edits were applied.
